resources.string: Base URL of the robot\'s remote server. The robot\'s IP is DHCP and changes, so use \"Find robot\" below rather than editing this by hand. Accepts a bare host:port too (e.g. ROBOT_IP:8765).

The robot publishes its current IP to an ntfy.sh topic on boot and every 5 minutes, so it can still be found after its DHCP address changes. \"Find robot\" reads the newest message and loads that address.
